title: Gather love at the Guru's feet
summary: Mind and body are gathered by fastening love to the Guru. Fasten mind and body to the Guru's feet.
takeaway: Fasten mind and body to the Guru's feet.
lifeApplication: When attention scatters, pull one desire back under the Guru's gaze and let love gather the body too.

source.shortMeaning: Mind and body are gathered by fastening love to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When attention starts scattering, touch the forehead and pull one desire back under the Guru's gaze before it multiplies.
